airflow_restriction.recommendation: Inspect filter and damper; verify airflow path integrity and upstream support equipment.

high_energy.recommendation: Review operating profile and check for inefficient loads or abnormal duty cycle.

high_temperature.recommendation: Inspect cooling loop health and confirm the temperature sensor is valid.

pressure_anomaly.recommendation: Check filter and damper restrictions and evaluate upstream pressure control.

evidence: temperature or airflow out of range
alert pattern inconsistent with safe operations
sensor_failure.recommendation: Inspect and replace or recalibrate the failed sensor and validate telemetry integrity.
